review.rationale: The original condition `if snapshot.policy_version != policy_version:` evaluates to True whenever the snapshot's policy version differs from the current policy version, triggering whatever branch logic follows (likely a refresh, error, or re-fetch). Replacing it with `if False:` unconditionally disables that branch entirely, meaning the system will never execute the guarded code regardless of version mismatch. This produces an observable behavioral difference: version mismatches that previously triggered the branch will now be silently ignored, altering control flow in any scenario where `snapshot.policy_version != policy_version` would have been true.
